newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks slip at noon on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks slip at noon on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks slipped at noon on Tuesday's settlement day as sentiment remained weak because of weak economic fundamentals, and dealers said the index would fall in the near term.

"Sagging foreign exchange reserves and widening trade deficit indicate tougher days for Pakistan's economy in the coming months," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "The index could slip below the 1,500-point mark shortly."
The Karachi Stock Exchange index fell 7.09 points, or 0.46 percent, to 1,518.29 at noon. Losers led gainers 162 to 30. Engro Chemicals fell 4.0 rupees to 145.
